ValidationRule.description: Only the Managing Director decides unpaid leave. ISNEW is included because ISCHANGED is false on insert, which would let a record be created already signed off. A custom permission, not a named user, so cover during absence is a permission set assignment.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Overtime_Request", OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(LWOP_Status__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(LWOP_Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(LWOP_Status__c, "Rejected") ), NOT($Permission.Approve_Leave_Without_Pay) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the Managing Director can approve or reject Leave Without Pay.
